claim: Baba Vanga authentically predicted an alien spacecraft would arrive in November 2026.
caption:
Did Baba Vanga predict an alien spacecraft would arrive in November 2026? The specific prediction circulating online has no authenticated original record establishing that she made it, according to IBTimes UK’s 14 October report. Repeating an attribution does not verify it. This November claim is separate from the November 13 population-model story.

Source: IBTimes UK, 14 October 2026.
https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/baba-vanga-november-2026-spacecraft-prediction-1825683

AI illustration — not actual footage.

Checked 30 October 2026. AI-assisted research, design and original illustration; independent automated review.
